reason: The README clearly describes a dsh web GUI plugin that visualizes conversation messages as a navigation rail and provides preview and jump controls, so navigation-panels is the primary category.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 网页聊天界面添加按用户消息定位的对话导航栏、悬停预览和上一条消息卡片。
summaries.en: Adds a conversation navigation rail, hover previews, and a previous-message card to the dsh web chat interface.

capabilities: Reads visible conversation messages to derive navigation anchors and previews
Adds a conversation navigation rail and previous-message overlay to the dsh web GUI
Scrolls the conversation to selected messages and expands the history window
